milestone.describes: Level 1 plays: Mr Fox on the branches with hazards and collectibles, and a live HUD showing level, a counting timer and health.

steps.expect: Main menu: the FANTASTIC MR. FOX title over the cast, with PLAY, Instructions and Audio off.
Choose a level: 18 numbered buttons in six named groups.
Level 1 story card -- the farmers have kidnapped Kristofferson -- with a Play button.
Gameplay. Level 1, the timer counting, the health bar full.

notes: No launch options. The window is 480x320 and the app renders to it directly.
A brief white bar flashes after window creation and before the loading screen. It is not part of the loading art and is not a failure; it is recorded in the app note as an open question.

If the window is horizontal bands of flat colour with no horizontal variation, the presented-texture wrap regression is back -- see ae10f9ab. That is a rendering failure, not a route failure, and no tap will get past it.
